messages:
Eli: dropped a few variants for multi-series display: overlay, stacked small-multiples, and a focus+context hybrid. figma: https://figma.redwood/multi-series-options
Maya: nice. quick thoughts: overlays get messy with >6 series. small-multiples preserve individual scale but lose easy cross-series comparison. hybrid might be best for dashboards where one series is primary.
Omar: agree. also units: if small-multiples each use local scale, we should show a tiny global-comparison inset that normalizes values so users can compare magnitude. label it clearly 'Normalized view'.
Rina: cleaning up legend copy: prefer full words over abbreviations on customer-facing dashboards. use 'Change (last 1h)' instead of 'Δ 1h'. also add a tooltip that explains normalization math.
Eli: outlier handling: proposal is to apply soft-clipping (visual cap with fade) and show an explicit sentinel marker with aria-label "clipped value: 98,432". add an action on marker 'Show raw' to toggle full scale.
ChartA11yBot: recommendations: focusable sentinel, aria-describedby with human-readable value and timestamp, and a skip link to jump to the normalized inset. Ensure color contrast for sentinel >= 4.5:1.
Maya: smoothing note: if we auto-smooth for long windows, include a small 'Show raw' pill that appears on hover for keyboard users too. keyboard users need a visible control.
Omar: backend: we can emit two arrays: downsampled_points and extreme_points flagged with overflow=true. front-end draws downsampled and overlays extremes. also include series_summary with p50/p95/p999 to help clipping heuristics.
Rina: legend behavior on narrow widths: collapse into search+filter flyout with a small sample row (swatch + truncated name + pattern). add a 'pin' icon to always show primary series on top.
Eli: performance/implementation: minimize DOM nodes for small-multiples (canvas for plots) but keep HTML for interactive overlays.
ChartA11yBot: reminder: use role=group for the small-multiples grid and aria-label per panel like 'Latency, service-A, last 24h'.
Maya: action items: Eli prototype hybrid layout with normalized inset by Thu; Omar draft API payload with extreme_points + summaries; Rina finalize copy for legend and sentinel CTAs; I'll run contrast checks.
Omar: will post API sketch later today.
Eli: thanks folks, I'll update figma and ping when prototype is live. :rocket:
